source_meta._disclaimer: Facility locations are approximate (city-level accuracy). Capacity figures are publicly reported estimates and may not reflect current state. Sources listed per entry.
source_meta._fiber_network_note: Empty by design. Earlier versions of this file hand-typed three named routes ("Zayo Northern Virginia Dark Fiber Ring", "Lumen/CenturyLink Iowa Backbone", "Zayo Pacific NW Fiber Route") with invented coordinate paths attributed to real carriers by name -- none were sourced from Zayo, Lumen, or any public filing. Attributing an invented path to a named company is a fabrication risk regardless of a map tooltip disclaimer, so they were removed rather than kept as "illustrative". No free, reliable, nationwide dataset of actual fiber routes is known to exist -- see js/parcel/proximity-layers.js's registerUnavailable('fiber', ...) for the parcel engine's position, which this file now matches. Only add entries here that carry a verified 'sources' array with a real URL, the same requirement data/validate_sources.py already enforces for data_centers/ai_campuses/power_infrastructure.
